podcast.body: Eddie Vedder was approached by his friend Sean Penn to compose the entire soundtrack for the movie *Into the Wild*, released in September 2008. He had previously contributed songs to a couple of Penn's films. "Penn wanted Eddie to do the soundtrack."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
